coreDescription.value: Core is the neutral baseline: shared semantic roles, accessible states, 48px targets and optional glass with an opaque fallback. Grass, Paper, Parallel, Canvas and Gallery map the same behaviour to their product purpose.

extendDescription.value: Use repository workflows and existing branding to choose colours, typography, symbols and materials. Verbalis uses Parallel; NotUX uses Canvas; Lexis uses Paper; Framio uses Gallery; Ambientis proposes Grass/Terra.

grassDescription.value: Pine and mint, soft 24px contours, calm responses and traceable evidence. Familiarity comes from stewardship, field records, permits and environmental responsibility. Green must not imply compliance without verified evidence.

heroDescription.value: Meridian Core defines trustworthy behaviour. Grass and Paper adapt its material, colour, shape and rhythm to the purpose of each product. A profile is more than a palette.

paperDescription.value: Warm paper, wine ink, restrained gold, readable pages and notebook references. Familiarity comes from books, lessons, annotations and progress. 24px surfaces and list items; 14px compact input details preserve the editorial vocabulary.
